oracle_policy: DeepSeek and GLM are subjects; Gemini is a blind independent comparison oracle. Reviewed expected outputs remain authoritative. Oracle success does not alone locate subject failure in model weights.

oracle_comparison.interpretation: Independent comparison only; endpoint and timing differ. Oracle pass does not identify model weights as cause.
